source_evidence.training_interpretation: Prioritize content-dependent episode-local semantic-to-symbol binding/routing while preserving already-observed semantic readout, symbol writeout and carrier algebra.

coordination.action: fuse only the nonredundant validator/render-integrity delta into the retained v3 path

finding.observed: The first parallel v3 derived target_template from private mapping/polarity metadata and checked that private field names were absent from the visible prompt, but it did not recompute the expected visible prompt from template + mapping + display order + semantic case + polarity and compare it byte-for-byte.
finding.counterexample: A visible codebook symbol can be changed while private realized_mapping and target_template remain untouched; absent an expected-render comparison, metadata-side mapping checks alone do not prove that the model saw the mapping used to derive the target.
finding.risk: A materializer or later transform could silently create prompt/target inconsistency or shortcut-bearing rows while the private metadata still validates.
finding.counterhypothesis: The generator itself is deterministic, so post-generation prompt drift will never occur.
finding.why_rejected_as_guard_policy: Later materialization/serialization is explicitly pending and is the stage most likely to rewrite aliases, token strings or envelopes; binding the visible render is cheap and fail-closed.
